evidence: GATE DIMENSIONS CARRY THE REAL GATE. scoring.toml:1-3 sets [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0; both gate judge.toml use aggregation='all_pass' with one binary criterion and the Playwright MCP server. test.sh:213-222 runs gates first, then score.py; exit 1 (gate failed) stops before the scored suite; score.py:41,48 zeroes reward unless every gate passes. (1) render (gates/render/judge.toml:23): 'An incorrect password leaves the visitor signed out ... the correct password for a seeded Recruiter ... then signs in and shows a usable staff workspace with navigation and readable content ... A static picture or only a health response is insufficient.' That is the auth leg, with a positive control (prompt.md:9 'A valid sign-in immediately after the invalid attempt is the required positive control'). (2) constraints (gates/constraints/judge.toml:23): through ordinary UI, create a uniquely titled job (title, team, manager, 2 places) and a candidate (unique name/email, any source); then 'In a new independent empty browser context sign in as the Observer ... find that same job and exactly one card for that candidate in Applied ... A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate.' prompt.md:9 forbids API-only writes and says 'A reload or a second tab of the same context is not independent.' This is the server-backing leg and meets REVIEW_POLICY 'Gates must exclude convincing dead apps': health or static JSON is not enough, and it needs a real write plus an independent-context readback. Every gate input is public: team, source and 1-50 places are in hireops_rules.md:27-31, the Observer reads the board (rules:18), accounts and password are in instruction.md:17, and new cards start in Applied (rules:31). The gates grade no permissions or stage rules (render: 'Permissions and workspace rules belong to scored outcomes'; constraints: 'Do not grade stage rules, conversations or live updates here'). EVERY SCORED PROMPT RESTATES AN IN-DIMENSION GATE THAT HARD-ZEROS. functional/prompt.md:9-13 '## Global browser gate ...' includes the same create plus independent-Observer readback and 'A blank or static shell, an unavailable app or an observed failure of that check gives every binary criterion 0'. All 44 functional criteria are type binary (grep of judge.toml), so the zero covers everything. polish/prompt.md:9-12 has the same check and 'gives binary0 throughout'; all 5 polish criteria are binary. visual/prompt.md:9-12 has the same check and 'gives every criterion its minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero'; all 5 visual criteria are likert points=5. No scored prompt gives partial credit when its gate fails (the skill's named defect). Every in-dimension gate signs in as Recruiter and Observer, so it has an auth leg, and its independent-context readback is the backing leg. NO SAME-ORIGIN REQUIREMENT. grep -i 'origin' over tests/ finds only functional judge.toml:200, where 'the original successful move' is an unrelated word. No prompt restricts CDN or off-origin assets, which matches instruction.md:13 and integration.md:12-14. Server-backed is checked by independent-context readback, not by origin, as quality-checks.md:147 notes. Missing evidence: 'NOT EXERCISED — evaluator/tool limitation' gives binary 0 or Likert 1 in every prompt, so missing evidence never earns credit. TOOL FEASIBILITY. The prescribed browser_run_code_unsafe exists in @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 (pinned in tests/Dockerfile:19) under README 'Core automation' (line 1043), not behind a --caps opt-in, so the gate's independent context is reachable with the configured args. A 'supported separate-context tool' alternative is also allowed. TEMPLATE. The template's scored gate says 'if the gate fails, assign 0 to every criterion in this dimension'; the task keeps that semantics, tightens it with a backing leg, and does not weaken it. BROKEN APPS THAT MIGHT PASS (tried, all excluded): a static shell or seeded-only JSON fails the unique-record readback; a localStorage-only app fails the empty independent context; any-password-accepted fails render; a health-only server fails both gates. An app keeping data only in server memory passes the gates, which is correct: hro_restart grades durability as scored difficulty, per REVIEW_POLICY 'Keep unrelated difficulty in scored outcomes'. CONFORMING ALTERNATIVES THAT MIGHT FAIL (tried, none found): an app with a different landing view still meets render's 'a job board, conversations or activity'; one without drag or with any route or labels is fine because prompts say 'Discover routes and controls by intent'; the Observer default may be another staff account ('another working staff account is acceptable'); a refusal message on a wrong password is optional. GOLDEN FEASIBILITY (scripted, not judge): workspace.cjs:219-235 shows a wrong-password refusal, sign-in, then opening a job through the UI form (title, team, manager, places) and adding candidates that land in Applied. board.js:43 pre-fills Source='Careers page'. results/workspace.json lists 'board: open a job, add candidates ...' and 'observer reads the board ...' as passed. All raw-evidence hashes re-verified as matching. RESIDUAL RISK (why risk=true): raw-evidence-index scope says 'Full configured grading/workload ... and Oracle/target scores are absent.' No configured RewardKit judge run shows the golden passing either gate under claude-code/GLM, that browser_run_code_unsafe's page.context().browser().newContext() works under --isolated in that harness, or that a dead or static mutant is zeroed by the actual judge. The design passes on source. Measured gate behaviour remains missing evidence, and a pass does not prove a portal or Oracle result.
